concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-onboard-users-terms-of-service]] — 2026-09-15 Adyen for Platforms Terms guide for main-entity document generation, individual or authorized-signatory acceptance, test/live type differences and acceptance-info retrieval; examples do not prove actual legal consent or capability enablement.
warnings: Acceptance is a legal action by the individual/authorized signatory for the correct main entity and document; no account or provider operation was performed.
The test-only adyenForPlatformsAdvanced type and sample accepted response do not identify a live user's required documents, actual acceptance, current legal terms or allowed capability.
The guide states no universal Terms revision/version identifier or re-acceptance rule.
